decision: Retain exact tun2socks 2.7.0-gephtun.3 binary, source archive, patch, modules, toolchain, and official Wintun 0.14.1 DLL. Fresh offline source execution, reproducibility, and upstream screening passed; no evidence justified a dependency replacement.
resource_qualification: Mixed lifecycle total-descriptor samples contain cached Linux splice pipe pairs from the mock TCP echo. Additional source-overlay observations found no residual sockets after complete scenarios and returned to baseline. The isolated 20-round failed-association fixture returned 8 descriptors/3 goroutines every round. See go-resource-observation.json and report; do not relabel the mixed raw samples as all eight.
limits: All new dependency runtime execution was Linux; the rebuilt Windows executable was compared as bytes, not executed.
Fresh vulnerability results are public advisory/version/package range screening, not symbol call-graph analysis or proof of absence of all vulnerabilities.
Imported Windows normal-operation evidence is retained and reconciled separately; no new 1.3.5 Windows route/firewall/driver/traffic execution occurred.
Two imported STUN peers provide narrow live UDP evidence. General UDP compatibility, failure containment, and IPv6 enforcement are not established by this dependency run.
Imported baseline IPv6 canary was unreachable, so its subsequent failure cannot prove firewall enforcement; consult review/audit-1.3.5/history/reconciliation.json.
